summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community include proposals for integrating HashiCorp Vault KMS support and adding relative paths to the v4 specification. The community is also preparing for an upcoming meetup in Boston and reflecting on the Iceberg Summit 2026 planning process.
highlights: Integration of HashiCorp Vault KMS support proposed
Discussion on adding relative paths to v4 spec
Retrospective notes from Iceberg Summit 2026 Selection Committee
